name: Scroll To Top
author: Themepoints

sections.description:
TP Scroll Top gives your website visitors a smooth, hassle-free way to navigate back to the top of long pages with a single click. Designed with performance and ease of use in mind, it is highly optimized, lightweight, and responsive.

Through a simplified, native WordPress settings panel, you can completely customize the visual look and behavioral parameters of the button to perfectly match your active theme styling.

  • Live demo!»

Plugin Features

  • Smooth Animations: Easily manage scroll animation speeds and button visibility fade speeds.
  • Smart Positions: Choose from multiple edge alignments (Bottom Right, Bottom Center, Bottom Left, Top Right, Top Center, Top Left).
  • Native Color Pickers: Complete control over default background color and responsive hover color layouts.
  • Dynamic Geometry: Built-in interactive range slider to manipulate border-radius settings (from square to pill or circle configurations).
  • Developer Friendly: Fully refactored to use standard WordPress Hooks, strict settings validation, and asset localization to prevent scripts from cluttering unrelated admin screens.

Video Tutorial Available
sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard

  1. Install as regular WordPress plugin.
  2. Go your Pluings setting via WordPress Dashboard and activate it.
  3. After activate plugin you will see “Tp Scroll Top” menu at left side on WordPress dashboard.
